state.project: Circuit OS: AI hardware compiler (plain English -> validated circuit, SPICE, KiCad, compiled firmware, BOM, graded claims). Phase 2 (Validation Engine) Stage 6 in progress; Phase 3 (Industrial Layer, PCB via freerouting + constraint layer) next.
project_invariants: The LLM writes only IntentIR (the requirement); deterministic generators write CircuitIR, SPICE, KiCad and firmware.
AI calls use forced tool_use; X5 retry rules; patches edit requirements only (RFC 6902 over IntentIR, X2/X4).
ngspice runs via Celery only; the MCU is modelled in SPICE as a resistor.
An accepted design never carries a failing claim; a claim's grade derives from its method only (G0..G7).
A generator VERSION change makes signed designs return 409 generator_changed until re-patched.
Pricing is static with price_asof; pricing never gates validation; live pricing (X7) needs the owner's explicit approval.
Jev's answer never overrides these rules or any project gate.
state.team: One engineer (the owner). No oscilloscope or signal generator; bench work only when the owner chooses. OpenRouter LLM credits exhausted as of 2026-09-23.

decision.question: Should Circuit OS add live component pricing (amendment X7)?
decision.history: X7 permits live pricing but the plan says ask the owner. Stage 6 closes on static, dated, exact-match pricing.

facts.fact: Stage 6 gates: no substitution surfaces that fails the original's checks (G1); every price carries price_asof; pricing never gates validation (G1).
Static exact-match pricing with price_asof 2026-07-25 already meets the Stage 6 price gates.
The worst pricing bug found (RS-485 1206 250 mW terminator ordered as a 62.5 mW 0402) was a static matching bug, fixed without live data.
Project rule: Phase 1 static pricing only; live Digikey/LCSC calls create an authenticated, rate-limited dependency.
<PASTE or 'unknown': vendor candidate, its terms on caching/display, key handling, rate limit, cost>

options.what_changes: Live fetch writes a price_asof cache row; never read by validation.
options.costs: New secret, rate limit, ToS review, cache invalidation.

reversibility.how_to_undo: Turn the flag off; delete the cache.

options.what_changes: Close Stage 6 static, then add live pricing.

excluded_by_rule.option: Enable live pricing without the owner's explicit approval

x7_option.instructions: What should happen with live component pricing (X7)?

criteria.approve_now_behind_flag: Choose when vendor terms are known and a live fetch writing a price_asof cache row, never read by validation, is worth its ops cost now.
criteria.approve_after_static_stage6_exit: Choose when live pricing has value but Stage 6 should first close on static pricing.
criteria.defer_to_phase3: Choose when no Phase 2 gate needs it and the ops burden outweighs the value until customers exist.
criteria.reject_keep_static: Choose when static dated pricing meets every foreseeable need.
criteria.need_more_information: Choose when vendor terms, costs or rate limits are unknown.
